# Zingo Assist

> Zingo Assist is a US virtual assistant agency (office: 7901 4th St N Ste 23684, St. Petersburg, FL 33702; phone +1 424-542-7170) that supplies trained remote assistants to real estate agents, brokers, investors, property managers and small businesses. Every engagement can start with a free 2-day trial.

Core specialties: real estate virtual assistants, real estate cold calling (agents, wholesalers, investors), transaction coordination, virtual property management, lead generation, CRM management, and real estate digital marketing / SEO / web development.

## Real estate services
- [Real Estate Virtual Assistant](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-virtual-assistant): dedicated VAs for agents and teams (admin, CRM, listings, ISA calling, transaction support).
- [Real Estate ISA Services](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-isa-services): outsourced inside sales agents for lead response, qualification, nurture and appointment setting.
- [Listing Coordinator Virtual Assistant](https://zingoassist.us/listing-coordinator-virtual-assistant): MLS input, photos, listing copy, showing feedback and seller updates.
- [Expired & FSBO Cold Calling](https://zingoassist.us/expired-fsbo-cold-calling-services): callers who book listing appointments from expired and FSBO lists.
- [Real Estate VA ROI Calculator](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-va-roi-calculator): estimate monthly cost, hours freed and break-even closings.
- [Real Estate Cold Calling Services](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-cold-calling-services): outbound prospecting and appointment setting for agents and brokers.
- [Wholesale Real Estate Cold Calling](https://zingoassist.us/wholesale-real-estate-cold-calling): motivated-seller calling for wholesalers and investors.
- [Real Estate Transaction Coordinator Services](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-transaction-coordinator-services): contract-to-close coordination.
- [Virtual Property Management Services](https://zingoassist.us/virtual-property-management-services): tenant communication, rent reminders, maintenance coordination.
- [Real Estate VA – Tampa & St. Petersburg, FL](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-virtual-assistant-tampa-st-petersburg-fl): local page for Tampa Bay agents.
- [Real Estate SEO](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-seo-services), [Real Estate Digital Marketing](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-digital-marketing-agency), [Real Estate Web Development](https://zingoassist.us/real-estate-web-development-services)
